description: Fork of exp154 (BitAttention, val_bpb=1.7105). Test temperature annealing: linear ramp on effective attn_scale from 1.0x at step 0 to attn_scale_target_ramp=10.0x at step n_steps. effective_scale = (attn_scale * ramp) / sqrt(D_QK_P). From analysis of exp144 converged attention: median top1-top2 popcount gap is 12 → post-softmax weight ratio top1/top2 ≈ exp(0.22) ≈ 1.25 (essentially uniform). Ramping scale 10x makes exp(2.2) ≈ 9 (moderately sharp). Tests if LUT path can use sharp attention when forced. If model genuinely prefers diffuse, learnable attn_scale collapses to ~0.04 to undo the ramp — diagnostic signal. Same kernels as exp154 (BitAttention TC fwd + bf16 bwd).
